row.name: Holy Spirit  Early Childhood and Primary School

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information obtained during the course of the investigation established that the operation failed to maintain adequate supervision when a child was left alone in the classroom without caregiver supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operations last sanitation inspection was completed on  09/26/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The outdoor play area is in need of loose-fill surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the course of this investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation within the required timeframe that a child in care received medical evaluation by a healthcare professional following an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The use zone to the sides of a slide do not extend to the required 6 feet. An additional 2 feet is needed on one side.     Note: The provider removed the slide during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual sanitation inspection has not been conducted since August 23rd, 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Education written in a foreign language was not translated to English for one out of four staff files evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: A small slide was observed installed over grass without the required loose-fill material or unitary surfacing.     Note: The play structure was removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the inspection a caregiver was observed changing diapers and did not have children was hands afterwards.      Note: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver was instructed to wash each child's hand after having their diapers changed before they go back to play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: 1 caregiver has not completed the skill-based portion for pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: Documentation of current liability insurance for the operation was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: Documentation showing the director has completed the full 30 hours of annual training was not available for review during the inspection. An additional 20 hours is needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection, a caregiver was observed with direct access to children in care. The operation has not obtained an eligiblity notification from CBCU stating the individual can be present.    Note: The caregiver left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Cribs in the infant room were not labeled for each infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests: 3 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain the original certificate of completion or a copy for CPR and First Aid training available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 4 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain proof of meeting education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: 3 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain the full 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual sanitation has not been conducted since August 9th, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: A child had not been signed in for the day.    Note: The caregivers noted the child's time of arrival on the attendance log in the classroom during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection, a caregiver was observed in a classroom and the operation did not have an eligibility notification from CBCU stating the caregiver could be present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: During the inspection infants were observed in their cribs with pacifiers that contained an attachment piece.     Note: It was discussed to only use pacifiers that do not contain attachments as they pose a risk of strangulation and suffocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained, the Licensing Incident Report was not shared with parents regarding a child that was left alone in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information, the operation did not report a situation that put a child at risk to CCR within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support that a caregiver was on their phone while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon the information obtained, a caregiver did not count the number of children before going outside and left a child alone in a classroom for approximately 2 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: Five classrooms were observed with children napping in the exit walkway.    This was corrected at inspection when each caregiver of the classes moved the children to another location.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Four caregivers was observed at the operation without notification of eligibility from the background check unit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: One caregiver was observed present at the operation in the 3 year old classroom with an inactive background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))
